description: Sets which data the app's pre uses: "own" (separate data, empty at first) or "pro" (the users' real data, which pre's unreleased code then reads and writes for real). Rooms are always pre's own. Signs out everyone in pre. Waits in the app's queue until neblla_promote "save". More: neblla_get_llms tools/pre_data
